entities.name: NR Sidelink Measurement Configuration
entities.description: Procedure where a UE configures its peer UE to perform NR sidelink measurements and reporting over a PC5-RRC connection using RRCReconfigurationSidelink message.

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationSidelink
entities.description: RRC message used to configure NR sidelink measurement parameters for unicast communication over PC5-RRC connection.

entities.name: NR Sidelink Measurement Object
entities.description: Specifies the NR sidelink frequency of reference signals to be measured by the peer UE.

entities.name: NR Sidelink Reporting Configuration
entities.description: Configuration for NR sidelink measurement reporting consisting of reporting criterion, RS type, and reporting format.

entities.name: NR Sidelink Measurement Identity
entities.description: Links one NR sidelink measurement object with one NR sidelink reporting configuration and serves as reference in measurement reports.

entities.name: NR Sidelink Quantity Configuration
entities.description: Defines NR sidelink measurement filtering configuration with different filter coefficients for different measurement quantities.

entities.name: Maintains NR Sidelink Measurement Lists
entities.description: Both UEs of the PC5-RRC connection maintain NR sidelink measurement object list, reporting configuration list, and measurement identities list.

entities.name: Reporting Criterion
entities.description: Criterion that triggers UE to send NR sidelink measurement report, which can be periodical or based on single event description.

entities.name: RS Type DMRS
entities.description: Specifies that only DMRS is supported for NR sidelink measurement in this release.

entities.name: Reporting Format RSRP
entities.description: Specifies that only RSRP measurement is supported in the reporting format for this release.
